calibration: Pool CV-A/B validation impostor-candidate scores; choose minimum strict cut giving empirical scored acceptance <= target. Freeze before test scoring. Never fit to the known genuine scores.
scope: One target registration; already observed Common Voice clients are impostor candidates, not newly recorded people. Target identity overlap with corpus is unverified. Existing genuine recordings are retrospective diagnostics, not independent tests.
duration_policy: Whole source recordings with original boundaries; no crop or re-alignment. Report whether selected sequences fit live 8-second clip and 20-second total limits. Reference screening is not a simulation of the live microphone protocol.
adoption: No live authentication threshold or model/profile changes
